name: AVW Bluegrass Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top title, left vacant at its launch and put up in a tournament seeded by a Bluegrass Rumble. The first final, Jake Davids against Chris Collins on 26 February 2001, ended with Davids pinning Collins after outside help, and the co-president at ringside took the belt back and ruled the match a no-contest, ordering a cage-match rematch for Bluegrass Bash.

name: AVW Appalachian Championship
epitaph: The promotion's second singles title, vacant at its launch in January 2001 and held by Dan Debacle by the end of February. His defence against Leevon Parks on 26 February 2001 was broken up by Seth Alexander's chair, and Alexander and Parks were booked to fight for the number-one contendership at Bluegrass Bash.

name: AVW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: First awarded on 5 February 2001, when the Board of Education beat Drake and Justice with the K-12 Dropout and were handed newly made belts, only for Southern Tradition to storm the ring. The two teams' feud brought the titles to Bluegrass Bash.
